sloka: कच्चित्त्वां नावजानन्ति याजका: पतितं यथा ।उग्रप्रतिग्रहीतारं कामयानमिव स्त्रिय: ॥ २.१००.२९॥
transliteration: kaccittvāṁ nāvajānanti yājakā: patitaṁ yathā ।ugrapratigrahītāraṁ kāmayānamiva striya: ॥ 2.100.29॥

translations.english: A learned person but skilled in contrivances, a warrior with passion for wealth and a man ever engaged in corrupting the minds of servants must be slain. A king who does not kill them is himself killed in due course.
